identity: Gor Drazhak musters the Throng; round its walls scorpions, hyenas and a bandit ration-broker take their cut.

quests.title: Our Word, Our Witness
quests.text: [PH] Chapter 1 (The Throng): the capital's envoy has a reported case of true records turned to a false claim and sends the player to The Oathdelvers' leader at the Miner's Guild house of this capital. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Drava Flintshoulder: she stands by a pledge kept and will not let it become the receivers' debt, and takes up the case. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Thorga Roadspeaker: stolen supplies are billed again to the very people they were meant for; Drava Flintshoulder at the Miner's Guild house knows the pledges behind them. A reported case: Thorga does not claim the player helped Rokka. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Drava Flintshoulder: she stands by a pledge kept and will not let it become the receivers' debt, and takes up the case. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Nalo Pathdrum: an extorted levy is treated as if the community had pledged it; Ombali Ropekeeper at the Miner's Guild house tests the claimed witness. A reported case: Nalo does not claim the player helped Veko. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Ombali Ropekeeper: she keeps what someone witnessed apart from what is slipped under their name later, and takes up the case. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Ossa Quietregister: remains and names are parted and used for strangers' claims; Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house checks the register entries. A reported case: Ossa does not claim the player freed Hollis. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Iven Lastshift: he keeps a name on the register apart from any claim about the person who bears it, and takes up the case. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: Chapter 1 opens at the envoy at 19 with no prerequisite; a walk to the capital's Miner's Guild house.

quests.title: Whose Word Is This?
quests.text: [PH] Chapter 1 (The Throng): a handover in the capital is disputed; the player secures its original record at the spot and brings it back, and the leader refuses the false claim. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Drava Flintshoulder: she refuses the new claim and has the water issued as pledged. The Oathdelvers stand by the delivery; the receivers owe nothing for it. Where the papers came from stays open; a like case waits at Ossuary Reach. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Drava Flintshoulder: a confirmed water delivery is to be issued at the depot on the rim of the cook court. The receivers' names and the handover's witnesses were moved onto a new claim, so those supplied would owe more service or pay. Secure the original handover record there and bring it back. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Drava Flintshoulder: she refuses the new claim and has the water issued as pledged. The Oathdelvers stand by the delivery; the receivers owe nothing for it. Where the papers came from stays open; a like case waits at Ossuary Reach. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Ombali Ropekeeper: supplies for porters are held at the landing beside the shore store. A witnessed help with the unloading is made to prove a standing pledge of the same helpers. Secure the original witnessed record there and bring it back. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Ombali Ropekeeper: she names which act was witnessed and which claim goes beyond it. A name under a handover witnesses that handover, nothing later. Where the papers came from stays open; a like case waits at Ossuary Reach. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Iven Lastshift: personal belongings wait in the receiving court outside the mourners' hall for their rightful receivers. True register entries were used to claim a debt on them, or a right to hold them back. Secure the original record there and bring it back. Real text to follow.
variants.completion: [PH] Iven Lastshift: he keeps the names and their right order and strikes the attached claim. A kept name gives no stranger's clerk a say over the person or their belongings. Where the papers came from stays open; a like case waits at Ossuary Reach. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A spot in the capital town (a town place) and back; the leader decides the capital's case, the papers' source stays open.

quests.title: A Sentry Needs Both Feet
quests.text: Gor Drazhak's sentries should be watching for enemy banners, yet half their night goes to watching their ankles. Kill eight Dust Stingers after dark on the {name:steppe}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:steppe}. A sentry hopping on one foot frightens nobody.

quests.title: Optional: Lunch Is Not Included
quests.text: Kill eight Dustpack Hyenas by day in the {name:badlands}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:badlands}, and keep our supply carts moving. They follow the rations as though we packed lunch for them; if they want a meal from the Throng, they can learn to carry a spear.

quests.title: His Profit, Our Empty Bowls
quests.text: Bandit Ration-Broker Garr buys Korr's stolen supplies and charges hungry fighters for the privilege of getting them back. At the {name:tollcamp}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:tollcamp}, kill six Toll Archers and Garr himself. Let Garr learn what the Throng charges for stealing its supper.

quests.title: Your Place in the Line
quests.text: You have seen what it takes to keep the Throng fed and marching. Now report to Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post on Bannerbreak Mesa, where our fighters hold the line. Drek judges fighters by what they carry up the ramp, not by what they say at the bottom of it.

quests.title: The Ladle Commands
quests.text: Warriors can argue about who leads the march; at supper, every last one answers to my ladle. Bring me eight pieces of Raw Meat and two Braided Sinew from the Quaggas that graze the {name:badlands} by day. We have ration bundles to tie and a hungry muster to fill them for.

quests.title: Spears Out, Word Back
quests.text: Speargrass Wellhold keeps sending us spears. Brakka Jarward wants word back, and you look ready for a walk. Travel to the Wellhold in Speargrass Reach and speak to Brakka for me. If Brakka asks about my stew, say the bowls come back empty.

quests.title: Salt Keeps a Friendship
quests.text: Our troll allies send fish from Whisperreed Landing, and our salt makes the return journey. Go to Whispering Reedlands and speak to Taleko Drycord at the landing. Give our allies a hand; a shared cooking pot holds the Throng together as surely as any war banner.
